model.instrumentation: Actual app HTML/CSS and Renderer. App response only predeclares its readback context and exposes accessors. The app animation instance is suspended for controlled real-Game fixtures.
model.capture: Actual UI screenshot is the fixed backdrop; each live arena canvas is composited at its measured DOM rectangle. No HUD or audio behavior is evaluated.

scopeNote: Capsule projection and Golem native Hurt/paused death ghost. Source hashes are the actual frozen bytes tested. New species, role scales and ranged lunge/hit/preview heuristics are outside this review.
